short: Neckband EMG with on-body inference at 20.5 mW (M13) but no on-device accuracy; repositioning recovery by labeled fine-tuning is standard (M03); sensor reused from 2025.
position: The paper [@spacone2026silentwear] changes deployment (M13), running a 15,489-parameter CNN on the neckband, and training (M03), fine-tuning on new-session batches. The sensor (M05) is the authors' 2025 neckband [@meier2025neckband] [concurrent], with its hardware reused (§III-A). M13 is the strongest part: 20.5 mW including inference is below every read wearable that streams raw data [@meier2025neckband; @wu2024necklace; @tang2024throat], but the quantized on-device model has no accuracy figure (§IV-E), so the deployed path is unvalidated. M03 is standard: supervised recovery after electrode repositioning dates from 2005 [@maierhein2005session], and no label-free baseline is run. The headline 77.5% silent accuracy tests days already in training; an unseen day gives 59.3% (Table II).
